name: Ecosia tree-planting partnerships
summary: Ecosia pays established tree-planting organisations through service or investment contracts to plant and look after trees, favouring native species and biodiversity hotspots. Organisations submit a short proposal form for review.
reporting: Partners must provide proof of their planting activities and meet Ecosia's monitoring requirements.

geography.quote: But we support projects all over the world and plant trees where we know they will have a positive environmental and social impact.
